comments.text: Reproduced before fixing: new focused Chromium regression fails in both light and dark modes because the hovered retrieval category description is covered. Root cause: I changed the original low-alpha decorative gradient into an opaque accent surface on an absolute full-card layer. Positioned header content remained visible, while the unpositioned description painted underneath. Removed those layers from the three hub/provider template positions and the equivalent email navigation card; preserve the existing DS card hover border/shadow and all links/events. No existing assertions changed.

Fix validation so far: mix q passed; 34 focused LiveView/CardShell tests passed; complete channel E2E spec passed 15/15 across Firefox, WebKit and Chromium. New regression exercises existing card hover on hub, retrieval providers, data-source providers and email navigation in both themes, without changing existing tests. Browser measurements confirm hovered descriptions are exposed and retain semantic text contrast (light #43536d on white; dark #A0B2C8 on #0d141c). Before/after hover screenshots and hover-observations.json are in /tmp/zaq-twk-evidence. Final mix precommit is running; no commit or push.
